blocks.text: Aldehydes primary alcohols ki oxidation se banaye jate hain. Is ke liye acidified (acid mila hua) K₂Cr₂O₇ ya acidified KMnO₄ istemal hota hai.

Ethanal banane ki misal mein acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ drop wise (qatra qatra) garam ethanol mein dala jata hai. Jo aldehyde banta hai use bante hi distil kar ke (bhaap bana kar) nikal liya jata hai. Is tarah ethanal aage oxidise ho kar ethanoic acid nahi banta. Temperature acetaldehyde (ethanal) ke boiling point se oopar lekin ethanol ke boiling point se neeche rakha jata hai, kyun ke ethanol ka boiling point acetaldehyde se zyada hai. Pure (khalis) ethanal redistillation (dobara distillation) se milta hai. Ketones bhi secondary alcohols se isi tareeqe se bante hain, lekin in conditions (halaat) mein ketones carboxylic acids mein nahi badalte, is liye ketone ko foran distil karne ki zaroorat nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai 'preparation of ethanol', lekin yahan ethanal (aldehyde) banaya ja raha hai; ethanol to shuru wala alcohol hai.

blocks.alt: Apparatus: H2SO4(aq) wala gol flask water ya oil bath mein, jis ka temperature aldehyde ke boiling point se zyada hai; neeche se heat. Side neck mein jhuka hua dropping funnel K2Cr2O7(aq) aur alcohol dheere dheere daalta hai. Thermometer ka bulb side arm ke barabar. Tircha condenser (paani neeche se andar, oopar se bahar) test tube mein aldehyde distillate tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.1: Ethanol ki oxidation se bante hi ethanal ko distil kar ke nikalne ka apparatus (aala) (kitab ki Figure 23.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flask mein pehle se dilute H₂SO₄(aq) hai aur woh garam water ya oil bath mein rakha hai. Funnel se K₂Cr₂O₇(aq) aur alcohol ka mixture dheere dheere tapkaya jata hai. Ethanal bante hi vapour (bhaap) ban kar side arm se condenser mein chala jata hai, kyun ke bath ka temperature ethanal ke boiling point (21 °C) se zyada lekin ethanol (78 °C) se kam rakha jata hai. Thermometer ka bulb side arm ke saamne hai taa ke nikalne wali vapour ka temperature naapa ja sake. Condenser mein thanda paani neeche se andar aur oopar se bahar jata hai, aur aldehyde distillate tube mein jama hota hai. Kitab ke text mein acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ garam ethanol mein dala jata hai, jab ke figure mein K₂Cr₂O₇ aur alcohol dono funnel mein hain; dono tareeqe chalte hain, asal baat yeh hai ke ethanal foran distil ho jaye.

Methanal, HCHO, room temperature par gas hai. Yeh aksar 40 % aqueous solution (paani mein ghula hua) ki shakal mein milta hai jise 'formalin' kehte hain. Is ki smell (boo) tez aur buri (unpleasant) hai, aur yeh biological specimens (jaandaron ke namoone) preserve (mehfooz) karne mein istemal hota hai. Baqi chhoti chain wale aldehydes aur ketones liquids hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein 'Methanol, HCHO' aur formalin ki 'fishy' (machhli jaisi) boo likhi hai. HCHO methanal (formaldehyde) hai, methanol (CH₃OH) nahi; aur formalin ki boo tez aur chubhne wali (pungent) hai, machhli jaisi nahi.

blocks.prompt: Ethanal bante hi distil kar ke kyun nikala jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Warna acidified dichromate use aage oxidise kar ke ethanoic acid bana deta. Bath ka temperature ethanal ke boiling point se oopar aur ethanol ke boiling point se neeche hota hai, is liye sirf ethanal bhaap ban kar nikalta hai.

items: Primary alcohol + [O] (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ya KMnO₄) → aldehyde + H₂O.
Aldehyde bante hi distil karein taa ke acid tak oxidation na ho; pure ethanal redistillation se.
Formalin: methanal ka 40 % aqueous solution, specimens mehfooz karne ke liye.
